WITH qc_projects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.fundflux, p.arcregistry
  FROM scanqc sq
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
grouped_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as project_count
  FROM qc_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
)
SELECT 
  fundflux,
  project_count,
  CAST(project_count AS REAL) / SUM(project_count) OVER () as fraction_of_total,
  CAST(project_count AS REAL) * COUNT(*) OVER () / SUM(project_count) OVER () as count_div_avg
FROM grouped_counts
ORDER BY fundflux
